description: cellpy is a Python library for reading and comparing battery cycling experiments. It imports different tester formats, converts them to a common data structure with battery metadata and provides methods for analysing individual tests or collections. Spatial coverage is a laboratory cell or test programme, not a fixed grid or vehicle, and the time span follows the selected cycling files. The public repository and package documentation are MIT licensed. Standardized capacity and degradation curves can help calibrate storage models for electric vehicles or stationary grid assets. A caveat is that laboratory cycling regimes and temperature may differ from field operation; converting formats does not make results from unlike cells directly comparable. No directly related catalogue record was established. The JOSS summary, own repository and README were read without obtaining test files or processing experiments. The prepared curves provide inputs to a battery simulation.
name: cellpy battery-test processing
